About

Free live ship tracking, unfiltered

A live ship map fed by AIS receivers that volunteers run around the world with the open-source AIS-catcher software: no filtering, no delay, no paywall.

More

What you can do here

  • Follow ships live on the map: position, speed, course, destination and track of any vessel in range.
  • Find a ship by name, MMSI or IMO number with the search on the map, and open its own page with the latest AIS data.
  • See the AIS coverage of the network and the receiving stations that hear a vessel.
  • Watch a station's own live dashboard, or decode AIS NMEA messages online.
  • Build your own AIS receiver with a Raspberry Pi and an SDR, and add your station to the map.
